# E2 background look

- Establish the first version record for this previously unversioned environment look.
- Replace the shared paper base-color atlas with generic warehouse documents and notices. Remove Unreal Engine promotional graphics, Marketplace Guidelines printing, the factory rendering and the software node-graph screenshot. Replace the two remaining gradient documentation covers with plain ivory STOCK LOG tables in the final review refinement. The former factory and software-graph panels are generic stock-register and inventory-list tables. Adopt the complete generated 1254-square RGB PNG without resizing or compositing, from the original 1024-square reference.
- Preserve every USD layer, mesh UV, geometry, binding, transform and physics value. Preserve the 1024-square paper normal map and ORM map. This does not certify a new SimReady handled prop.
- The atlas is sampled by thirteen binders in the common E2 background and packing-bench dressing. DB-L1 through DB-L4 images may change; their existing videos retain their recorded appearance. The owner excluded L1–L4 from this dataset refresh, so this change does not claim those releases were regenerated. A later matching-appearance release can re-render saved states without recollecting state/actions.
- Record source/output hashes and tool prompts in the internal review receipt. No new copyright ownership, license or trade-dress conclusion is asserted.
